REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-52274  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Climate Resilient and Sustainable
  City Commission meetings of Wednesday, December 6, 2023 and Thursday,
  January 25, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-52275  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from City staff on Sea Level
  Rise & Flooding and the Climate Action Plan.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-52276  Recommendation to review the 2024 Office of Climate Action and Sustainability
  Work Plan, provide input to staff and forward to the City Council for approval.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Climate Resilient and Sustainable City Commission on non-agenda
items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the
Chair.
